summary: End-to-end test of the driver 'email app link' flow on https://naughty-hugle-13.preview.emergentagent.com. The web app was served on :3000 and the public /api routes to the local backend. Clerk sign-up through the UI is blocked for automation by Cloudflare Turnstile ('Verify you are human') in the Clerk dev instance. The OTP step was never reached. Workaround: created dockqa+clerk_test@example.com through the Clerk Backend API and signed in with a sign-in ticket (/sign-in?__clerk_ticket=...). The user then went through Onboarding, which created the fleet 'TEST_QA Haulers' (America/Chicago). In the UI: /app/loads/new, then manual entry with broker and driver email delivered@resend.dev, then save. On the load page, driver-email-card shows the email and there is no missing note. Email driver the app link shows the toast 'App link emailed to driver' and driver-last-email reads 'App link · ... · sent' (Resend email_id returned). The recap button shows 'Recap emailed to driver'. A one-time App link schedule was saved (row appeared) and deleted (row gone). Edit terms with the email cleared brings back the missing note and disables the email/recap/schedule buttons; re-adding the email re-enables them. fleet.app_url equals the preview origin. load-open-driver-link /api/open/{token} returns 200 HTML with dockclock://d/{token}?api=https%3A%2F%2Fnaughty-hugle-13.preview.emergentagent.com; an invalid token returns 404. Backend pytest: 15/15 passed.

minor.issue: driver.email is not validated or normalized on save. A typo like 'bob@' saves fine, then email-driver returns 400 'Add the driver's email first', which is misleading because an email is present. Validate with EMAIL_RE on save (400 'Enter a valid driver email') or change the send-time message to 'Driver email looks invalid'.
The copy tells the driver to 'press Start trip', but the driver app button is now 'Start ride' (see iteration_10).

issues: The sonner toast (top-right) briefly covers the header user email/avatar and the 'Edit terms' button. This is cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: validate driver.email format on POST/PUT /api/loads, or give a clearer error at send time.
Optional: update 'Start trip' to 'Start ride' in the driver link email and the SMS text.

FYI: Clerk dev sign-up shows a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha, so automated UI sign-up (OTP 424242) can't finish. Future testing should use /app/tests/clerk_helper.py (Backend API user plus sign-in ticket), or turn off bot protection in the Clerk dev dashboard.
critical_code_review_comments: fleet.app_url is last-writer-wins from any valid https origin passed to GET /api/me. If an owner opens the dashboard from another domain (e.g. a production custom domain), all later emailed/scheduled links switch to that domain. This is acceptable, but worth knowing.

load-open-driver-link uses a relative href '/api/open/...'. That is fine while the web app and the API share an origin; it breaks if the web app is ever hosted on a different origin than REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Using load.driver_url would be safer.
server.py is 1794 lines; consider splitting into routers (loads, driver emails/schedules, driver public endpoints).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (UI sign-up via captcha not automatable; ticket sign-in used)
